trainsInFileNote: Counts describe the whole capture. trains.json keeps only trains from feeds whose licence allows redistribution: DELFI, VBB, KVV, VBN, SNCF, OpenOV, Luxembourg ATP and Trafiklab. Trains from other neighbouring feeds were removed.

categoryCodes.ld: IC, EC, FLX and other long distance
categoryCodes.rfast: RE, IRE, MEX and other fast regional
categoryCodes.foreign: Trains from neighbouring countries' feeds (display only)

positionMethod: Each train placed along its current stop-to-stop segment polyline by elapsed time (static snapshot for design only; the product uses motion plans along matched shapes, ADR-0001).
attribution: Train data: Transitous (MOTIS) over DELFI e.V. timetable and realtime (CC BY 4.0, CC BY-SA)
Map data: OpenFreeMap, OpenMapTiles, OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL)
